verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only an official MCP server for driving Lorikeet from AI assistants. That belongs to a separate MCP-server story and does not count as a documented public API (REST, GraphQL or similar). The docs index (llms.txt) lists only the MCP server under Reference, and the line about the agent acting 'through your APIs' refers to customers' own APIs, not a Lorikeet API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
